name: Suddenly She's Here
source: Everything was going just fine for Oscar until one day when he woke up to find a girl in his room. Her name is Mika and she claims to have known him and his family for a long time. However, Oscar doesn't recognize her at all but to make things even more confusing, everyone around him is acting like she's always been around! As he spends more time with her, he will uncover the mystery of who she really is, assuming he doesn't try to run away from all of this. Just who is this girl and why is she messing is his life up?
translation: 对于奥斯卡来说一切都很顺利，直到有一天他醒来发现自己的房间里有一个女孩。她的名字叫米卡，她声称认识他和他的家人很长时间了。然而，奥斯卡根本不认识她，更让事情变得更混乱的是，他周围的每个人都表现得好像她一直在身边一样！随着他花更多的时间和她在一起，假设他不试图逃避这一切，他就会揭开她的真实身份。这个女孩到底是谁？她为何扰乱他的生活？
